reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual third-round review of external-03 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 07 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face/hair crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

entries.positive_observation: External-03 is unmistakably the compact yellow naiwa mascot with green-ringed black eyes, not a photorealistic human. It restores close-cropped brown/gray-brown side hair on the high crown and distinct dark eyebrows. The face has one restrained closed mouth and no spectacles or added beard; the ambiguous narrow upper-lip detail was not broadened. The nearly frontal slightly viewer-left pose and chest-up crop remain. The dark olive uniform retains red/gold collar patches, gold shoulder trim and a small pale throat detail. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The note has exactly two compact upper gray-mark rows with two groups per row, no third row or lower-left dash, and largely blank lower paper. The complete dark tilted frame, opaque gray-olive backing, cream note and right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: The narrow upper-lip dark pixels do not reliably distinguish fine hair from shadow, and the small partly occluded throat detail and exact insignia are not fully readable. These source-resolution uncertainties are not rejection reasons; yellow mascot identity, side hair, eyebrows and note layout are directly visible.
